contrastRestoration.fit: leave-one-photo-out over the other 26 held-out photos

fidelity.transformerEvaluation: displayed exact checkpoints scored against held-out truth on the robust hull; the chart interpolates between checkpoints

alignment.clock: source raw120 rows recovered from t_abs and source timestamps
alignment.admission: four-bin token [s,s+3] included when s+3 <= t+10
alignment.betweenCheckpoints: linear interpolation between adjacent exact prefix frames, equally weighted by fixation progress and exact accumulated token progress

transformerProgress.terminalPolicy: shipped all-token bundle; no prefix inference substituted

display.calibration: single terminal truth-matched affine, fixed for all prefixes
display.range: single terminal in-hull q01/q99, fixed for all prefixes

transformerProgress.renderingPolicy: every fixation renders a distinct state from fixation and admitted-token progress; exact checkpoint frames are interpolation anchors
